scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing the domain controllers, the PKI and DHCP servers, the administration hosts, the core router, and SBD-REPO01 sending their records to the collector SBD-SYSLOG01.
scene.completeCaption: Every existing source pushes its record to SBD-SYSLOG01: Windows events by subscription, the router's denies and SBD-REPO01's messages as syslog. Courses 1.4 and 1.5 pick up the two streams from here.

nodes.name: SBD-SYSLOG01
nodes.title: SBD-SYSLOG01 · 10.0.20.20
nodes.description: The collector this course builds. A source-initiated subscription fills ForwardedEvents, and its syslog receiver takes the router's denies on UDP 514 (F24) and Linux senders over TLS on TCP 6514. It reaches into no source.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: Built in course 1.1. Lesson 2 reconciles its audit policy with the course 1.1 STIG GPOs, lesson 3 enrolls it as a source, and lesson 5 traces a failed sign-in from it.

nodes.name: SBD-DC02
nodes.title: SBD-DC02 · 10.0.10.11
nodes.description: Built in course 1.1 and audited by the same GPOs as SBD-DC01. Its forwarded events keep the MachineName SBD-DC02, which is how the central copy shows where each record came from.

nodes.name: SBD-REPO01
nodes.title: SBD-REPO01 · 10.0.70.20
nodes.description: Built in course 1.2. In lesson 5 it becomes the first Linux source, forwarding its syslog over TLS to the collector on TCP 6514 (rule F07).

nodes.name: PKI + DHCP
nodes.title: SBD-SUBCA01 · SBD-PKI-MGMT01 · SBD-DHCP01
nodes.description: SBD-SUBCA01 and SBD-PKI-MGMT01 from course 1.1 and SBD-DHCP01 from course 1.1. Lesson 3 adds them to SBD Event Sources, so their Security logs and time events reach the collector like the controllers'.

nodes.name: ADMIN HOSTS
nodes.title: Admin hosts · 10.0.60.0/24
nodes.description: AdminJumpBox01, SBD-ADMIN-SRV01, and SBD-ADMIN-PC01 from course 1.1. Their sign-in events join the first collection scope, and SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 is where the collector is administered from.

chapters.network: Only the design exists: SBD-SYSLOG01 is planned on VLAN 20. The domain controllers, PKI and DHCP servers, admin hosts, core router, and SBD-REPO01 already run, but no events flow yet. SBD-AUDIT01 and SBD-SPLUNK01 arrive in courses 1.4 and 1.5.
The domain controllers on VLAN 10 and the admin hosts on VLAN 60 now write the designed event families to their own Security logs. Nothing is forwarded yet; the collector is still planned.

SBD-SYSLOG01 on VLAN 20 is online. Both domain controllers, the PKI and DHCP servers, and the admin hosts push events to it over WinRM 5985 (F17), and the core router's deny log arrives as syslog on UDP 514 (F24).
The same flows run into SBD-SYSLOG01. This lesson watches them from the collector's side: each source's heartbeat, the log's oldest event, the data volume, and each syslog sender's daily file.

Every source is live: the Windows sources forward over WinRM, the core router sends its denies on UDP 514 (F24), and SBD-REPO01 joins over syslog TLS on TCP 6514. One sign-in, one deny, and one test message reach SBD-SYSLOG01.
